verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical, so they share the same flaws. The RSVP Free CTA has been shrunk into the badge row and reads as a fourth tag rather than the main action. The left column (presents line, tagline, URL) is tiny and only barely legible, and the time and venue sit far right, cut off from 'Saturday 21 June'. A stray dark bar left over from the partner asset trails the TASTINGS pill, the can icon is crammed into the middle, and the logo is pushed to the right edge, so the reading order is scattered.
